title: Dial Tone
blurb: The North American dial tone — 350 Hz and 440 Hz played together, the exact sound of picking up a landline in 1995. Gen Z hears a mysterious drone; everyone else hears their childhood kitchen. Use it in edits for instant retro-telephone energy, as a they-hung-up-on-me punchline, or as the world's most confusing notification sound. Synthesized to spec, free to download.
origin: Precise synthesis of the standard North American dial tone (350+440 Hz).
